## Authorized scope

- Create a machine-readable one-entry-per-gate disposition map before deleting the H3 validator, using exactly ACTION_EXISTING, TEST_EXISTING, ACTION_OR_TEST_REQUIRED, HISTORICAL_ONLY, or RETIRE_OBSOLETE.
- Classify each of the two current H3 failure categories as exactly CURRENT_RESOURCE_CONTRACT_DEFECT, MISSING_FOCUSED_VALIDATION, OBSOLETE_H3_ONLY_INVARIANT, or HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_INCONSISTENCY and act through the current owner.
- Replace live phase-era H3 replay and completion dependencies with maintained explicit-input composition over current generic Actions, project-local interfaces, focused commands, and structured immutable results.
- Reconcile live callers, resource registrations, maintained tests, public imports, and current documentation while preserving manifests, schemas, fixtures, vectors, profiles, descriptors, skills, and accepted historical evidence.
- Use one root-owned implementation path and at most one final read-only harness integration review after focused validation.

## Completion criteria

- The gate disposition map contains exactly one disposition for every original H3 gate and demonstrates a coherent current owner for every retained requirement.
- The two current failure categories have exact classifications and contract-consistent dispositions without making the old H3 validator pass merely to obtain a green historical result.
- No live caller, current manifest, selected profile, route, replay, completion check, or maintained documentation depends on validate_h3_resources.py or current H3 phase terminology.
- The maintained replacement accepts explicit roots and profiles, returns a structured immutable result, orders deterministically, distinguishes invalid input from internal failure, propagates nested failures, and performs no Git mutation or implicit repository discovery.
- Focused tests, public-import checks, Ruff, focused mypy, documentation-link checks, git diff checks, dependency checks, historical-tree identity checks, and the single bounded integration review pass before the historical validator is deleted.

## Exclusions

- Do not rewrite accepted H3 tasks, checkpoints, reviews, checksums, or retained evidence, and do not recreate obsolete H3-only invariants elsewhere.
- Do not add executable completion drivers under .pi/tasks or .pi/evidence, another replay system, repository-root discovery, a plugin framework, generated orchestration scripts, or implicit current-working-directory authority.
- Do not add dependencies or lockfile changes, implement SQLite or P3 work, run scientific or external calculations, or perform publication, release, protected execution, or unrelated repository-wide campaigns.
- Treat the completed failed parent review as correction input; do not reinterpret it as a passing review or rewrite its retained result.
